On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 10:03 AM laura_bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Markus / Priyom — forwarding FinHealth's redline.

Laura — quick take below, recommend we present a single compromise redline to their counsel:

1) Retention: Accept for pilot only. Counterlanguage: "For the pilot period (defined as 90 days following activation), Redwood will retain derived user metrics for up to 18 months for research and QA purposes, after which such metrics will be deleted unless otherwise agreed in writing." Include requirement that FinHealth provides an attestation of purpose and we log access.

2) HIPAA / BAA: We do not sign a standalone BAA for pilot customers. Offer scoped PHI-handling addendum: "If PHI is transmitted, the parties will execute a mutually agreed PHI Addendum prior to processing; Redwood's obligations will be limited to encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, and standard technical safeguards. Redwood will not accept responsibility for customer-controlled inputs that are PHI without a signed PHI Addendum." That keeps risk limited while giving them the operational guarantees.

3) SCCs: Provide standard SCC addendum as an option. We can accept inclusion as a fallback clause limited to situations where data is transferred outside the US. No need to preemptively apply SCC obligations for a US-only pilot.

SOC2 / KMS: Provide SOC2 Type II summary + auditor letter; full report only under NDA. For KMS, confirm that customer-managed KMS (Bring Your Own Key) is supported for Dedicated / Private but not in hosted tier without additional onboarding — propose a technical appendix explaining options.

Routing & timeline: Recommend DocuSign flow to contracting@finhealth.com with legal@finhealth.com in view-only. I can draft the compromise redline and run by legal; need their turnaround 24-48h.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Legal Operations (Contracting)

Laura / Markus — a couple of technical points to include in the response so FinHealth's engineers and security team are satisfied:

- KMS: we can support customer-managed keys in our Dedicated and Private offerings. For hosted sandbox/pilot, we can offer envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys and customer access logs; include an option to migrate to CMK if they move to Dedicated.
- PHI: if they send PHI, we need clear data flow diagrams and DPIA scoped to that processing. Ask them to confirm types of data and volume.
- Retention enforcement: we'll enforce deletion via lifecycle policies and provide an audit log (S3 lifecycle + eventing). Include a short tech appendix (suggested filename: technical-kms-summary.pdf).

I can draft the appendix and a short SOC2 artifact bundle (summary + auditor letter) to attach.

Emma — thanks for the redline and for the clear asks. We reviewed internally and can move forward with a limited compromise for the pilot. Summary of what we can accept and next steps: 

1) Retention: We will accept a timeboxed increase for the pilot only. Proposed compromise language (attached in the redline): "For the pilot period (90 days following activation), Redwood will retain derived user metrics for up to 18 months solely for research and QA related to the pilot. Access to retained metrics will be logged and limited to personnel listed in the Appendix."

2) HIPAA / PHI: We cannot sign a standalone BAA for a short pilot. Instead, we will include a scoped PHI Addendum that must be executed prior to any PHI transfer. It limits Redwood's obligations to technical safeguards (encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, logging). For any PHI processing we will require the DPIA and data flow diagrams you noted.

3) SCCs: We will reference our standard SCC Addendum as a fallback if transfers outside the US occur. For the pilot (US-only), SCCs will not apply.

SOC2 & KMS: Attaching a SOC2 summary and the technical KMS appendix (see attachments). We can provide the full SOC2 report under NDA if your counsel requires it. For KMS, customer-managed keys are supported on Dedicated / Private; for hosted pilot we can offer envelope encryption and detailed audit logs.

Signature routing: We propose DocuSign for speed. Please confirm the signing order:
- Primary: Emma Li / FinHealth Senior Counsel (sign)
- CC: contracting@finhealth.com
- Redwood signatory: Markus Klein, VP Legal Ops

I attached a single compromise redline (redline_final_laura_20261201.docx) that incorporates the language above. If that looks acceptable, we'll send a DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/signing/FH-042-DSIGN

Attachments: redline_final_laura_20261201.docx; SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf; technical-kms-summary.pdf
